package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class C14 extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  private Clock.Ticket b;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), x, null); b = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(9), y, null); }
  public void stopped() throws Exception { super.stopped(); logCancelRequest(a); cancelled(b); }
  private void logCancelRequest(Clock.Ticket t) { log("cancel requested"); }
  private boolean cancelled(Clock.Ticket t) { return t == null; }
}
